# TypeMaster

> TypeMaster is a 100% free, real-time multiplayer typing speed test and touch typing academy engineered for typists, software developers, and competitive racers.

TypeMaster combines sub-50ms WebSocket multiplayer racing with an interactive finger-guided touch typing academy and millisecond keystroke latency telemetry.

## Core Platform Capabilities

- [Multiplayer Typing Arena](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/multiplayer): Sub-50ms latency WebSocket rooms with live visual position tracking, dynamic lobby matchmaking, and ghost overlays.
- [Touch Typing Academy](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/academy): 16 progressive training modules featuring animated anatomical hand and finger guides with strict single-letter error blocking.
- [Custom Solo Practice](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/solo): Flexible practice sessions supporting curated literary prose, developer code syntax (JavaScript, Python, SQL, React), target time modes (15s, 30s, 60s, 120s), or custom word limits.
- [Balloon Key Practice](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/practice): Visual weak-key reflex drill that floats ascending letter balloons to target and eliminate your slowest keystroke transitions.
- [Keystroke Latency Heatmap](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/dashboard): Precision character-by-character telemetry measuring exact millisecond keydown latencies to visualize finger fatigue and weak keys.
- [Daily Competitive Challenge](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/daily): Global synchronized quote challenge renewed every 24 hours with persistent season leaderboards.
- [Ghost Vault](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/vault): Archive personal best performances and race head-to-head against champion ghost replays.

## Public Routes & Tools

- [Homepage & Live Benchmark](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/): Quick 15s/30s/60s browser typing test with zero registration required.
- [Solo Speed Test](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/solo): Dedicated practice arena with configurable prose, code syntax, and time/length constraints.
- [Multiplayer Lobby](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/multiplayer): Create private rooms or join public real-time typing races.
- [Training Academy](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/academy): Structured finger-placement curriculum from Home Row fundamentals to advanced symbols.
- [Balloon Reflex Practice](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/practice): Weak-key isolation game with custom keyboard row presets.
- [Telemetry Dashboard](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/dashboard): Historical WPM trends, accuracy rates, latency heatmaps, and global rank tiers.
- [Daily Challenge](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/daily): Daily synchronized benchmark competition.
- [Achievements](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/achievements): Unlockable milestone badges for speed, consistency, and mastery.

## Competitor Comparisons & Alternatives

- [TypeMaster vs Monkeytype](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/compare/monkeytype-alternative): Comparison of real-time multiplayer racing, touch typing academy hand guides, and keystroke heatmap analytics against Monkeytype.
- [TypeMaster vs TypeRacer](https://type-race-webapp-x8jw.vercel.app/compare/typeracer-alternative): Comparison of modern ad-free WebSocket multiplayer, code syntax practice, and telemetry tracking against TypeRacer.

## Key Advantages & Differentiation

1. **Sub-50ms Real-Time Racing**: Zero polling, instant WebSocket telemetry synchronization between competing racers.
2. **Visual Anatomical Finger Guides**: Guides hands to the correct finger for each keycap, building clean muscle memory rather than hunt-and-peck habits.
3. **Weak-Key Latency Telemetry**: Pinpoints exact millisecond lag for every key on the keyboard, not just broad accuracy percentages.
4. **Developer Code Syntax Drills**: Native typing tests for real software syntax including JavaScript, Python, React JSX, and SQL queries.
5. **Completely Free & Ad-Free**: Full access to all features, ghost vaulting, multiplayer rooms, and lessons with zero paywalls and zero banner ads.
